preserving.description: Uses explicit index loops and a single joined write instead of zip.

files.solve.py:
with open("matrix.tsv", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
    lines = fh.read().split("\n")

rows = []
for line in lines:
    if line != "":
        rows.append(line.split("\t"))

width = len(rows[0]) if rows else 0
out = []
for j in range(width):
    out.append("\t".join(rows[i][j] for i in range(len(rows))) + "\n")

with open("transposed.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
    fh.write("".join(out))

preserving.description: Uses the csv module with a tab delimiter and no quoting, writing newline-terminated rows.

files.solve.py:
import csv

with open("matrix.tsv", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
    rows = [row for row in csv.reader(fh, delimiter="\t", quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE) if row]

with open("transposed.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
    writer = csv.writer(fh, delimiter="\t", quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE, quotechar=None, lineterminator="\n")
    for column in zip(*rows):
        writer.writerow(column)
